name: bouncelens-email-check
description: Check email addresses for typos, disposable domains and dead domains. Runs locally, no API key.
long_description: Finds mistyped domains (jane@gmial.com → jane@gmail.com), disposable/throwaway domains, domains that don't exist or have no mail server, bad syntax, role addresses and duplicates (Gmail dot and +tag variants count as the same inbox). Runs on your machine with no API key or account; the only network calls are DNS-over-HTTPS lookups of the domain's MX/A records (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1). It never connects to the recipient's mail server, so the best result is "unconfirmed". Same checks as the free checker at [bouncelens.com](https://bouncelens.com/).

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Check one email address: syntax, domain typo, disposable, role address, domain exists / has a mail server

tools.name: check_emails
tools.description: Check up to 500 email addresses at once, with a summary and duplicate detection
